48V 18 Ah (864Wh)LithiumBattery

The electric bike comes with a powerful 48V 18Ah (864Wh) lithium battery that delivers outstanding performance and durability. With an impressive cruising range of up to 88 km per charge in pedal-assisted mode and around 53 km in pure electric mode, this bike is perfect for long rides and daily commuting.
1000W BrushlessHigh Speed Motor

The QIHANG motor on this electric bike is a powerhouse, boasting a peak power of 1000 watts and a maximum torque of 82Nm. Whether you're looking to zip around quickly or cruise effortlessly in assisted mode, the QIHANG motor has got you covered with its impressive strength and performance.
Hydraulic Disc Brakes

The bike equipped with hydraulic disc brake systems has more sensitive brakes and safer driving.
M5 LCD Multi-function Display

The electric bike is equipped with an LCD multi-function display that provides valuable information such as speed, mileage, power usage, and more. The display also features a convenient backlight for easy reading in all lighting conditions. Additionally, you can easily adjust the assist level based on the terrain and your personal preferences. This bike's LCD display also allows for full customization of speed options and other security settings to make your ride safe and enjoyable.
Suspension Fork WithLock

This electric bike is equipped with a sturdy suspension fork that features a lock-out lever and preloaded spring stiffness adjustments. With a maximum compression of 100mm, the suspension system effectively absorbs bumps and shocks, especially on complex and rough routes, reducing rider fatigue and allowing for faster, smoother riding. Whether you're tackling uneven terrain or cruising along smooth roads, the suspension fork on this bike provides excellent support and improved comfort.
Super BrightHeadlights

Integrated LED headlight and horn, 260 lumen. High visibility to ensure your safety when riding at night.
Studry Rear Rack

Equipped with extended fenders and a solid rear rack for easy transportation.
Hydraulic Brake Lever

Aluminum alloy, with a brake sensor, cut off the power to the motor when braking. Detail improvements add a touch of happiness to your ride.
Smart Phone Holder

The phone holder is equipped with a usb charging socket for navigation anytime, anywhere. It can charge your dying cell phone.
Shimano 21 Speed

Shimano's 21-speed cassette allows you to switch gears at will, and combined with the pedal assist system, you can adjust the most suitable speed to complete your journey.

Charging methods
Charge directly or take the battery out for charging

Motor
Rear drive 1000W high speed, brushless, geared hub motor

Max speed
50 km/h (Adjustable speed limit to 25km/h)

Brake levers
Aluminum alloy, cut off the power to the motor when braking

Brakes
DYISLAND Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes
